peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 16.9% above its local comparables; 31 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (24.5): 2.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 13 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 75% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 1996.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,500,000 ($1,548 psf, 968 sq ft; 5 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,347 psf (range $1,204–1,442); 14.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $195,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,015,000 ($1,686 psf, 1,162–1,194 sq ft; 7 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,419 psf (range $1,099–1,946); 18.8% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $319,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: One-North MRT about 610 m, Buona Vista MRT about 760 m; closer than 8 of 63 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Fairfield Methodist School (Primary) about 450 m; more than 17 of 63 similar developments (the same as 19). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 290 m), more than 28 of 63 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Ghim Moh Road Blk 20 about 850 m; nearest park One-North Park about 430 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 560 m; The Hill @One-North, 14 new sales, about 680 m; Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 1,270 m; Lyndenwoods, 7 new sales, about 1,530 m; Bloomsbury Residences, 123 new sales, about 1,640 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,720 m; Elta, 81 new sales, about 1,890 m; Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 1,930 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 69 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,269 new sales and 264 resales (1,533 purchases); new sales were 82.8% of these purchases. Subsales (11) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dover Drive GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 550 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 264 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 6 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 264 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 281 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6%). Planning-area private resales −1.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
